root_cause.text: The Bluetooth HIDP session removal callback (hidp_session_remove) does not release the l2cap_conn reference and clear the session->conn pointer, so that later when the session thread (hidp_session_thread) calls l2cap_unregister_user, it uses a dangling pointer to a freed l2cap_conn, causing a use-after-free.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds a NULL check for session->conn before calling l2cap_unregister_user in hidp_session_thread (line 1311-1313), and in hidp_session_remove it explicitly drops the reference and sets session->conn = NULL (lines 1168-1174). The commit message explicitly states "caused by not dropping l2cap_conn reference when user->remove callback is called". The KASAN report shows the UAF in __mutex_lock during l2cap_unregister_user, called from hidp_session_thread, after l2cap_conn_free had already freed the conn.
